verdicts.quote: when a place opens, the first eligible waitlisted member is booked automatically; no claim window or "confirm within N minutes" step.
a service-assigned sequence, not a client or wall-clock time, so two joins in the same millisecond still have a defined order … **Out of scope:** priority tiers, manual reordering, staff override
G-4b late-cancel/penalty/credit behaviour for a promoted booking made close to start (unknown; owner: product owner; interim: apply existing booking rules unchanged).
verdicts.missing: Promotion is automatic. The spec leaves open whether cancelling the resulting booking late or missing the class incurs a penalty.

verdicts.quote: as part of the same operation that opened the place** and before it returns … Ben cancels → Cai booked

class name, start time, "you were promoted from the waitlist" … in-app marker "promoted from waitlist" is always available; any existing outbound channel (ASM-5) is used in addition. … interim: one attempt, failure recorded … Cai still booked
Ana and Ben cancel, in either order → bookings {Cai} plus one free place; Cai is promoted exactly once … confirmed ≤ capacity, even under simultaneous requests
a waitlisted member cannot book directly (`ALREADY_WAITLISTED`), so no member is ever both. … concurrency resolved by serialising changes per class
payments, credit deduction or fees specific to waitlist (the existing booking rules apply as they do to direct bookings).
verdicts.missing: The payment rules being inherited are unspecified, including when a charge is taken and what happens to the seat and queue entry if it fails.

verdicts.quote: interim behaviour is **no cap**. … `WAITLIST_FULL` only once a cap exists (G-1a).
verdicts.missing: The release cap and the member-facing response when that limit is reached remain open.

verdicts.quote: Waitlist entries **end at class start**; promotions can occur at any time before start.
capacity +3 with 2 waiting promotes both and leaves 1 place for direct booking … If staff **reduce** capacity below confirmed bookings … no promotion happens until confirmed < capacity.
staff cancel class C-101 with waitlist [Cai, Dee] → both entries end `class_cancelled`; no bookings are created; both are notified.
creates one waitlist entry {class, member, join order, status} … an entry stores the member id, class id, order and timestamps only. … A member's position is 1-based and always contiguous
verdicts.missing: The stored order determines the current position, but the spec does not say which timestamp records when the member joined.

verdicts.quote: `expired` (class started) … Retention period of terminal records: unresolved (G-7b). … interim: keep, with no personal data beyond the member id
verdicts.missing: The spec gives no retention duration or deletion point for the expired record.

verdicts.quote: Members see **their own position** and the **total waiting count**, never other members' identities.

Staff visibility of waitlist contents: **not requested**, no staff screen is added … **Out of scope:** priority tiers, manual reordering, staff override … The terminal record keeps {class, member id, reason, ended-at}
verdicts.missing: Manual promotion is excluded. The spec leaves staff access unresolved and gives no staff workflow for removing a member or reviewing who was promoted when.

verdicts.quote: promotion has completed by the time the operation that opened the place returns
these remain exactly as before, and a regression check must pin each against the baseline: (a) booking a class with space and an empty waitlist … confirmed bookings still {Ana, Ben}.
